title: PILLAGER ROLES ARE WORN GEAR, NOT MARKS IN THE AIR
why: His answer 73 (10-18): drawn gear replaces the marks floating over pillagers heads. Rush wears spiked shoulder pauldrons, flank a knotted neck scarf, supp a bandolier with brass rounds and a hip ammo box, mark a hood framing the face and a shoulder mantle, shield a strapped arm plate. All drawn on the body and anchored to its bob, lean and crouch; nothing rises above the head but the hood rim. Colours and roles are unchanged.
now: Pillager role marks are now drawn gear worn on the body.
